root_cause: C:\Users\scott\AppData\Local\CivicCast\station-state.json begins with a UTF-8 BOM (ef bb bf). _load_raw_state() therefore raises JSONDecodeError, swallows it, and returns {}. read_live_captions_enabled() -> None, so resolve_live_captions_enabled() falls back to LIVE_CAPTIONS_DEFAULT=False. The caption FEED is thus disabled while the caption TAP is separately enabled via CIVICCAST_CAPTION_TAP, so cues are committed to active.vtt and never fed to the mux.
verdict: BLOCKED - proven at the feed->worker->mux hop by an overlapping run, with a specific, reproducible root cause
